sentences.text:
"Wherefore the petitioners above named most humbly pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the entire proceedings in Spl.C.No.29/2024 (Crime No.200/2023 of Gowribidanur Rural P.S.) on the file of Addl. District and Sessions Judge FTSC - I, Chikkaballapura for the offence punishable under section 376(2)(n)
of IPC, Section 9, 10 of NC: 2025:KHC:5747 Child Marriage Restraint Act, Section 5(J)(II), 5(n), 6 of POCSO Act, in the interest of justice."

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners - accused Nos. 1 to 5 and learned counsel for 2nd respondent - complainant have filed a Joint Memo dated 05.02.2025 duly signed by the petitioners, 2nd respondent and their respective counsel.
The same is taken on record.

3. Petitioners - accused Nos. 1 to 5 and respondent No.2- complainant are physically present before the Court and they admit the contents of the aforesaid Joint Memo, which reads as under:-
JOINT MEMO "The petitioner No.1 and the 2nd respondent submits as follows:

1. The petitioner and the 2nd respondent submits that, the petitioner have filed the above petition seeking to quash the proceedings in Spl.C.No.29/2024 pending on the file of Addl. District and Sessions Judge, FTSC - I at Chikkaballapura, for the offence punishable under section 376(2)(n) of IPC, Section 9, 10 of Child Marriage Restraint Act, Section 5(J)(II), 5(n), 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge, FTSC - I at Chikkaballapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The petitioners and the 2nd respondent submits that, the petitioners being aggrieved by the initiation of proceedings, the petitioners has preferred the above criminal petition.
The petitioners and the 2nd respondent submits that petitioners No.1 and the respondent No.2 are married.
The 2nd respondent consent to quash the proceedings against the petitioner.

4. The petitioners and the 2nd respondent submits that, the settlement arrived between the petitioners and the 2nd respondent is out of free will, there is no coercion or force, fraud or any undue influence in settling the case.

Wherefore the petitioner and 2nd respondent most humbly pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the proceedings against the petitioner in Spl.C.No.10304/2024 pending on the file of Addl. District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I at Chikkaballapura, in the interest of justice."
4.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I at Chikkaballapura
entities.label: COURT
